title: ReverieGear
description: Add more weapons and equipment to SilentGear!
body: # ReverieGear This mod adds additional compatibility to [Silent Gear](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/silent-gear). ## Optional Dependencies The following mods are not required, but if present, ReverieGear will enable compatibility features for them: * **Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks** * **Malum** * **L\_Ender 's Cataclysm** ## Newly Compatible Items The following weapons and equipment have been made compatible with **Silent Gear**, allowing modular customization and material-based trait application: ### Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks * Spell Books * Staff * Flameforged Sword * Auto-Crossbow ### Malum * Scythes * And More… ### L\_Ender 's Cataclysm * Meatgrinder * Forge Hammer * And More… > With ReverieGear, you can modularly customize these weapons using Silent Gear's material system. ## Acknowledgements * Thanks to [silentchaos512](https://www.curseforge.com/members/silentchaos512/projects) for creating the original [Silent Gear](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/silent-gear) mod. * Thanks to [Waffy](https://www.curseforge.com/members/waffy/projects) for providing the original 2D weapon textures for L\_Ender's Cataclysm. > **Found a bug?** > Please report it on the modpack's GitHub Issues page. **Other changes:** * Added the ability for the Material Disassembler to rewrite and disassemble alloys back into raw materials. Note: This mod does not add material compatibility, so without tweaking, you may not get certain material traits.
